dac-sfp.description: NSC-T48S-STND-DAC-B-SFP, the dual-AC build with two fibre SFP cages, as the Rear photograph shows it, with the two fan modules the Front photograph shows

description: 48-port auto-sensing serial console server, 1RU, with 14 USB-A serial ports. The data sheet's Front carries HDMI, a USB-A port, two lamps and a reset button. It also has two fan modules and twelve USB-A ports in six stacked pairs. The Rear carries the 48 RJ45 serial ports in two rows of 24, in three blocks of eight columns, odd numbers above even. It also has two SFP cages, the console RJ45 with a USB-A port beneath it, and two AC inlets each with a rocker switch. Modelled as the dual-AC, SFP build, NSC-T48S-STND-DAC-B-SFP, the one the held photographs show.

gaps.wanted: The rack ears and their positions. The data sheet says only "Front-Rear mounting brackets", and the rail kit sheet that "This kit replaces the Rack Mount Ears that are provided with each unit". No S document dimensions an ear or says where it bolts. The rear photograph on the rail sheet shows the ears folded back at the Rear, not measurable. `chassis.ears` is left out.

A Rear photograph of the single-AC and dual-DC builds and of the builds without SFP (two RJ45 Ethernet, ETH0 and ETH1, are named by the maker's text and drawn by no held figure). The 16 and 32-port builds have no photograph at all. The device is modelled as the one build the photographs show, and each other build is a configuration to add when its face is held.

The data sheet's ordering rows say "Fanless", the SFP row also "z-Fan Configuration", and the Front figure and the photograph show two fan modules. Which builds carry the modules, and whether they can be absent, is not stated.

A small black dot is printed or set above and left of each odd-numbered column, 24 in all. The photograph is too small to say if it is a lamp, a hole or a mark, and no document names it. Drawn as a dot of decor, with no meaning.
What the yellow and the green lamp of each serial jack and of the console jack show. The data sheet has no LED table; no guide is held.
The colours and meaning of PWR and SYS, and the reset button's behaviour. The Front figure prints the legends PWR, SYS and RST and nothing else.
A cross-head screw stands above the HDMI port. It is drawn as a screw head; no document names it.
How the 13 USB-A ports on the Front are numbered, which is the data sheet's "USB serial ports". No numeral is printed; the ports are counted in reading order, left to right, upper before lower.
Which way the lower USB-A port of each stacked pair faces. The photograph's lower ports look flipped; at 165 px tall it cannot be settled, so all twelve are drawn alike.
Any photograph or drawing of the lid, the base and the sides. None is held.

name: nsc-t48s

colour.note: The face is the median of bare plate in each photograph, #44606c (front) and #44606b (rear), a slate blue-grey. Lettering is white.

console-usb-bezel.note: The console RJ45 and the USB-A port beneath it sit in one bright metal frame, 16.7 by 21.0 mm. The jack's lamps are at its top, so the jack is turned 180 as the top row of the serial block is.

face-names.note: THE DATA SHEET'S WORDS ARE KEPT. Page 3 captions the face with HDMI, one USB-A port, two lamps, a reset button and the fan modules "Front", and the face with the 48 RJ45 ports, the inlets and the SFP cages "Rear". The ports are on the Rear, as on the maker's other serial consoles.

fans.note: Two fan modules on the Front, in both photographs (the T48S photograph and the data sheet's Front figure). The data sheet's ordering table says "Fanless" on both SKU rows and "z-Fan Configuration" on the SFP row; the photograph and the Front figure show the fans. The two modules are drawn seated and the disagreement is a gap. Their size is read off the photograph.

gate-1.note: Both photographs pass at low resolution: the front 854 px for 443 mm, 84 px tall for 43, aspect 10.2 against 10.3; the rear 857 by 84 px, 10.2. They show perspective at the edges. The Rear's SFP pair steps 15.1 mm and the registry says 15.0, which is the cross-check used.

power.note: Page 2: "Power consumption 45 W typical", "Single or Dual AC: 100-240 VAC, 50/60 Hz", "40V-63 VDC dual power input (redundant)". The Rear photograph's inlets are two IEC C14, turned a quarter turn (earth pin to the left), each with a rocker switch above it. The data sheet states no maximum draw and no fuse or current rating.

scale.note: EVERY POSITION IS READ OFF A 1024 PX PHOTOGRAPH, and the face is 857 px wide in each, so about 1.93 px per mm and a reading good to about 0.5 mm in the best case and 1 mm in most. The photographs are slightly off square: the rear's RJ45 pitch reads 14.16 mm (27.4 px) where the registry's ganged-jack pitch is 13.97. The registry value is used in the block and the block starts and gutters are fitted to the measured block edges, so the sum agrees with the photograph to 1 mm and the interior of a block to half a column.

serial-ports.note: Rear photograph and data sheet page 3: 48 RJ45 serial ports, numbered 1 to 48, odd above even, the numeral printed above the top row and below the bottom row, in three blocks of eight columns, with a printed gap between blocks (230.5 px, or 119.2 mm, from one block start to the next; eight pitches are 111.8 mm, so the gutter is 7.4). Each jack shows a yellow and a green lamp in its corners. The photograph does not name what the lamps mean and the data sheet has no LED table, so the lamps are drawn as the lamped jack part gives them and no meaning is stated.

size.note: Page 3, "Size (L X W X H): 443 X 312 X 43 mm", 1U. The labels read length, width, height, and 443 is plainly the body's width and 312 its depth. 443 is the body between the ears: the photographs show no ears. Weight 4.9 kg, "depending on options".

sources.note: Three documents and two photographs. ZPE Systems, Datasheet: Nodegrid Serial Console - S Series, April 15, 2026, page 2 (specifications, power), page 3 (interfaces, physical, ordering table, the Front and Rear figures); the same data sheet's page 1 (14 USB serial ports). ZPE Systems, Fixed Rail Mounting Kit For 4-Post Racks (RAIL-180-395), November 18, 2024. ZPE Systems, the end-of-life notice for selected rails, which carries the older rail ranges. Photographs from the maker's pages: the T48S front (T48S-4.jpg) and the T48S dual-AC rear with SFP (T48S-DAC-SFP-2.jpg), each 1024 px wide. No installation guide, drawing, CAD model or stencil is held.

usb.note: Data sheet page 3: "1X USB 3.0 Host & 13 USB 2.0 Hosts on Type A connector", and page 1 "14X USB serial ports". The photographs show one blue USB-A on the Rear (USB 3.0, by the blue tongue), and on the Front one lone USB-A and twelve in six stacked pairs: 13 white ports, the 13 USB 2.0. The datasheet does not say which port is the 3.0 one; the colour is the reading, and the stacked pairs' own numbering is not printed.
